cards.text: Jesus arrives in Bethany, where Lazarus, the brother of Martha and Mary, has died. Bethany is a little less than two miles from Jerusalem, and many people have come to comfort the two sisters. Friend, that house is FULL.

cards.question: When Jesus arrives, Lazarus has already spent ___ days in the tomb.

cards.text: Then Martha hears that Jesus is coming. Friend, with that many people in one house, I'm amazed anybody could hear ANYTHING.

cards.question: When Martha hears Jesus is coming, she and Mary both go out together to meet Him.

cards.text: Martha goes out to meet Him, but Mary stays at home. And Martha gets RIGHT to it: “Lord, if You had been here, my brother would not have died.”

cards.question: But Martha isn't finished. Even now, what does Martha say she knows?

answers.text: God will give Jesus whatever He asks
Lazarus is resting at peace with God
Jesus came as fast as He could

cards.text: “Your brother will rise again,” Jesus tells her. Five words, friend, and I've written longer notes on a cookie box.

cards.question: Martha says she already knows Lazarus will rise again. When does she say it will happen?

answers.text: In the resurrection at the last day
Three days after he was buried
Once the time of mourning is over

cards.text: Martha is thinking about the last day. Then Jesus says, and friend, read it SLOW: “I am the resurrection and the life.”

cards.question: Jesus tells Martha that whoever believes in Him will live, even though he dies.

cards.text: Jesus adds that everyone who lives and believes in Him will never die. Then comes the BIG question: “Do you believe this?”

cards.question: Jesus asks Martha if she believes this. What does Martha say she believes about Jesus?

answers.text: That He is the Christ the Son of God
That He is a great prophet from Galilee
That He is the prophet Elijah returned

cards.text: Martha heads back and pulls Mary aside, low voice, one sister to another: “The Teacher is here and is asking for you.”

cards.question: When Mary hears the Teacher is asking for her, she gets up ___ and goes to Him.

cards.text: Jesus is still out where Martha met Him, and when the people comforting Mary see her rush out, they ALL follow. Like when one coworker grabs her keys in a hurry and the whole office trails her out the door, already guessing where she's headed.

cards.question: Where do the people following Mary suppose she is going?

cards.text: Mary reaches Jesus, and the moment she sees Him, she falls at His feet. That's a sister who got up QUICK and didn't stop until she got there.

cards.question: When Mary reaches Jesus, she says the exact same words Martha said when she met Him.

cards.text: Jesus sees Mary weeping, and the people who came with her weeping too. Friend, slow down here: He is deeply moved in spirit and troubled.

cards.question: Seeing Mary and the others weeping, Jesus asks them a question. What does He ask?

answers.text: Who was with him at the end

cards.text: “Come and see, Lord,” they answer. Four little words, and I bet every one of them was heavy.

cards.question: Then come just two words: Jesus ___.

cards.text: Some of the people watching say, “See how He loved him!” Friend, love like that doesn't need explaining.

cards.question: Some of the people watching Jesus weep ask whether the man who opened the eyes of the blind could have kept Lazarus from dying.

cards.text: Jesus, deeply moved once again, comes to the tomb. I bet that's the last place anybody wanted to be standing.

cards.question: What kind of tomb is Lazarus in?

answers.text: A cave with a stone across the entrance
A pit dug deep into the ground
A grave under an oak tree

cards.text: “Take away the stone,” Jesus says. Martha, the dead man's sister, speaks right up, and friend, I've sugarcoated cookies for years, but Martha does NOT sugarcoat ANYTHING.

cards.question: Jesus wants the stone taken away from Lazarus's tomb. What does Martha tell Him?
Jesus answers Martha by reminding her that He told her if she believed, she would see the glory of God.

cards.text: So they take away the stone, and I bet you could hear a cookie crumb drop. Jesus lifts His eyes upward and says, “Father, I thank You that You have heard Me.”

cards.question: Jesus says He knew the Father always hears Him. So why does He thank the Father out loud?

answers.text: So the people will believe the Father sent Him
So the disciples will learn how to pray
So Martha will stop being afraid

cards.text: After He says this, Jesus calls out in a LOUD voice. Friend, I spent years in the dark of a junk drawer, waiting for somebody to call my name.

cards.question: Standing at the open tomb, what does Jesus call out in a loud voice?
The man who had been dead comes out with his hands and feet bound in strips of linen and his face wrapped in a cloth.
Lazarus is standing there all bound up, and Jesus tells them to ___ him and let him go.

cards.text: We're stopping right here, friend. Trust me, this story is still in the oven.
